:::{#def-rate-ratio}
#### Rate ratio

In a [Poisson regression model](poisson-regression.qmd#def-poisson-regression),
the **rate ratio** comparing [covariate pattern](logistic-inference.qmd#def-covariate-pattern) $\vx$ to covariate pattern $\vxs$
is the [ratio](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-ratio) of their [event rates](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#def-event-rate):

$$\rateratio(\vx : \vxs) \eqdef \frac{\lambda(\vx)}{\lambda(\vxs)}.$$

:::
